cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Ten is a numeric successful-request goal, not a cap on actual batch credit or operation ordinals. Prefer one free Help All batch per visit with no census or coin gate; positive unknown-count batches confirm and defer without invented credit.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Preserve numeric credit and separately confirmed successful batches across restart. Stop when actual successful numeric credit reaches at least ten, free Help disappears or one Help All batch finishes this bounded visit. Unknown-count success is confirmed and deferred, never invented completion. Operation ordinals are contiguous >=1 and uncapped by goal ten; actual numeric credit is never clipped.
bounded_recovery_behavior: A positively recognized existing Alliance menu, Alliance Help hub or fresh clear Speedup Help source may use at most three distinct route-owned Back steps to reach fresh canonical Home before normal entry. Exact reverse contexts are Speedup Help to hub to Alliance to Home; a positively recognized direct Home successor is also accepted. Each immediate source and changed expected successor is verified; unknown, changed or unchanged sources/successors stop without identical retry. Recovery consumes physical inputs, not Help quota, and never repeats or reconciles a Help effect. The intermediate hub must be positively recognized before opening only Speedup Help; alliance_help_hub_successor_unproven or speedup_help_successor_unproven stops without another input. Unknown target, cost, overlay, stale source, unchanged result, or unresolved request successor blocks further identical dispatch across restart. Preserve confirmed quota; use only a positively recognized safe return to canonical Home.
evidence_requirements: Current native evidence must bind a fresh Alliance Help source, exact free target and cost, immediate-before frame, transport result, immediate-after frame, semantic request successor, and terminal canonical Home.

Show attributable Help All acknowledgement with numeric credit when supplied, successful unknown-count batch deferral, no fabricated/clipped counts, preserved individual progress and uncapped contiguous operation identities across restart.
Offline policy evidence and current native acceptance remain distinct. This contract claims no live run; registration and scheduler admission remain disabled.
Only the route's own verified native results establish success; no Daily provider, D02, objective ownership, or points attribution is used.
